title: ITER welcomes last major component needed for core machine assembly
summary: The ninth and final vacuum vessel segment for the ITER fusion machine—vacuum vessel sector #2—has been delivered to the ITER Organization’s site at Cadarache, in southern France. With this delivery, all major components are now on-site for the construction of the “core machine” of the international project—including the vacuum vessel, superconducting magnets, and cryostat.

title: Eliminating Heat Risks in Nuclear Cleanup: A DOE Contractor’s High-Tech Blueprint
summary: For organizations like the Savannah River Mission Completion (SRMC), a liquid waste contractor for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Office of Environmental Management at the Savannah River Site (SRS) in Aiken, South Carolina, the summer season poses significant challenges for their workforce. In 2025, safety leaders sought to expand the current heat safety program and find a solution that would integrate proactive methods of heat stress mitigation across their 310-square-mile work site.
